Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Downtown Tucson (85701) is the cultural heart of Arizona's second-largest city, featuring UNESCO City of Gastronomy cuisine, vibrant arts scene, historic architecture, and unique Southwestern character. About 115 miles south of Phoenix, Tucson offers a distinct personality with Mexican heritage, university culture, and desert sophistication. A trip to Downtown Tucson is priced on the Phoenix to Tucson private shuttle page, per vehicle from the published hourly rates.

Neighborhood guide

Downtown Tucson preserves layers of history from Spanish presidio to modern arts district. Historic Fourth Avenue offers independent shops, restaurants, and nightlife. The El Presidio district contains some of Arizona's oldest buildings and the Tucson Museum of Art. Congress Street and surrounding blocks feature galleries, boutiques, and James Beard-recognized restaurants. The Arizona-Sonora connection infuses everything from architecture to cuisine.

Frequently asked questions

How far is Tucson from Phoenix?

Tucson is approximately 115 miles south of Phoenix via I-10. Our comfortable transportation makes the straight desert highway journey relaxing and enjoyable.

Do you offer Tucson food tours from Phoenix?

Yes! Tucson is a UNESCO City of Gastronomy with incredible Mexican and Southwestern cuisine. We provide day trips that include time to explore Fourth Avenue, visit historic restaurants, and sample local flavors.

Can you provide transportation to University of Arizona events?

We offer transportation to UA football games, basketball games, graduations, and campus events. Skip the parking hassles and arrive refreshed for Wildcat events.

What makes Tucson different from Phoenix?

Tucson has a distinct personality with stronger Mexican cultural influence, smaller scale, historic preservation, and unique Sonoran Desert character. Many visitors appreciate both cities for their different atmospheres.
